diagnostic_observation: All 16 mismatches generated by the one-event adjacency rule share the same raw-stream structure: a recognized score event (ordinary Shot/Free Kick+101 or tag102 own goal), optionally one intervening event such as Touch, Duel, or Goalkeeper leaving line, then goalkeeper Save attempt+101 for the scoring team's opponent. Thus the Save marker is a mirror duplicate at raw index distance 1 or 2. The genuine save-only marker previously diagnosed in match 2499781 has no recognized score event for the opponent in the preceding two raw events.

correction.recognized_score_event_set: ordinary Shot/Free Kick+101 scored by event team, plus tag102 own goal scored by opponent
correction.save_attempt_duplicate_rule: For Save attempt+101, inspect the previous at most two raw events in the same period. If any is an already-recognized score event credited to the goalkeeper team's opponent, ignore the Save marker as a mirror duplicate.
correction.save_attempt_fallback_rule: Convert Save attempt+101 to one score for the goalkeeper team's opponent only when no recognized score event for that opponent exists in the previous two raw events of the same period.
correction.integrity_gate: all selected regular-duration A01+A02+A03 matches must reconstruct exactly to recorded 90m score before coverage/model evaluation

interpretation_boundary: This is event-stream score canonicalization only. It cannot alter A03 membership, folds, matching, pair gates, state features, smoothing, model hyperparameters, metrics, bootstrap, or development-signal gates.
